title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
An exciting Data & Technology business in London is looking for a Lead Data Analyst to join their growing analytics team on an initial contract basis.

  • Based in London
  • 2 days a week in the office
  • 3 months initially
  • Start date: January
  • £400per day (Outside IR35)

The Job

As the Lead Data Analyst, your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and mentoring a team of analysts across multiple projects
  • Managing workloads, priorities and stakeholder expectations
  • Acting as the escalation point for complex technical and analytical challenges
  • Supporting the delivery of data-driven insights for commercial and strategic decision-making
  • Working closely with senior leadership to improve processes and ways of working
  • Driving automation and continuous improvement initiatives across the analytics function

You

  • Strong Python skills
  • Advanced Excel experience
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets
  • Knowledge of data modelling, data quality and validation techniques
  • Previous experience leading analytics projects and mentoring analysts
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience in AdTech, media, agency or start-up environments would be highly advantageous

Apply Now

You can apply for the Lead Data Analyst position now by sending us your CV or by calling us today. Don't forget to register as a candidate too.

Amy Brown
Associate Director
